content: Do I need to lift heavy to build muscle?

No, you don't have to lift heavy to build muscle. 💪 Research shows that muscle growth is similar across a wide range of loads, roughly 5 to 30 reps, as long as your sets get close to failure (about 0-3 reps left in the tank).

Heavy work in the 5-8 rep range is still the best way to build strength, and strength matters for your 100 kg bench goal. The best plan mixes heavy compound lifts with moderate-rep accessory work. Ain't nothin' but a peanut! 🏋️
